$comment: Agentic Resource Discovery. Spec v0.91 (github.com/ards-project/ard-spec), authored at Google, Microsoft and Hugging Face on the Linux Foundation AI Catalog data model. It points an agent at the machine-readable things we publish instead of making it guess from HTML. Mirrored at /.well-known/ai-catalog.json, the predecessor path, for readers written before the rename. Keep the two byte-identical.

entries.description: Batch speech-to-text: submit recorded audio, receive a transcript with speaker labels and word-level timestamps in JSON, TXT, SRT, VTT, DOCX or PDF. Automatic language detection across 99+ languages. $0.003 per audio minute with every feature included.
representativeQueries: transcribe a recording with speaker labels
who said what in this meeting recording
generate SRT subtitles from a video

entries.description: Local stdio MCP server exposing five tools: transcribe_audio, submit_transcription_job, check_job, get_transcript and list_jobs. Runs via `npx -y speechrevolutions mcp` and authenticates with SPEECHREVOLUTIONS_API_KEY.
representativeQueries: give my assistant the ability to transcribe audio

entries.description: API reference, SDK guides and quickstarts. Every page has a Markdown twin at the same URL with .md appended.
representativeQueries: how do I authenticate with Speech Revolutions

entries.description: How to obtain and send an API key. Keys are self-serve from the console; new accounts receive $10 of credit with no card required.
